items.title: Sault Ste. Marie council reopens data center rules Monday
items.dek: Sault council members will again debate limits on data centers after earlier pushback. The decision affects how much electricity and water a large facility could pull from the area grid and river. Chippewa County residents face higher utility costs if bigger projects win approval.
items.source_title: Sault council to revisit data centre issue on Monday - SooToday.com
items.judge_note: Concrete new development: a scheduled council meeting to debate specific data center limits on electricity and water usage.
